component.name: Tuxflix
component.summary: Watch and listen to your Plex library

description.p: Tuxflix is a native desktop client for Plex Media Server, laid out like a game library: a rail of every library, shelves of artwork, and a page for each film, series, artist and album.

ul.li: Films and episodes play inside the window with hardware decoding, 4K HDR included, from where they were left, with the audio and subtitles the server chose
Intros and credits skip with one press, the next episode is offered as the credits roll, and chapters show with their pictures
The server is asked how to play everything, and a lower quality has it convert the stream
Every library opens as a grid with the server's own sorts and filters, collections, playlists, people and a search across everything
Music plays gapless and loudness-levelled, with an equalizer and a compact player that wears classic Winamp skins
Picture in picture, media keys and the desktop's media controls

description.p: Tuxflix is a viewer: it never changes how the server is set up.
